name: Kannauj

queries.query: Kannauj Uttar Pradesh cadastral parcel map official Bhunaksha
queries.result: Official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha and the Government of Uttar Pradesh digitization dashboard were found. The dashboard reports Kannauj district cadastral-map linkage for all three tehsils, with two Kannauj-tehsil villages/mapsheets remaining unlinked or ungeoreferenced.

queries.query: कन्नौज उत्तर प्रदेश भू नक्शा आधिकारिक खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: आधिकारिक उत्तर प्रदेश भू-नक्शा सार्वजनिक मानचित्र मिला; कन्नौज जिला कोड 160, कन्नौज तहसील कोड 00834 और मानचित्रित गांवों की सूची सार्वजनिक स्तर-एपीआई से मिली।

researchNote: The official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha public viewer and its anonymous map service were evidenced. District 160 and tehsil 00834 resolved; village 147082 (कन्नौज कछोहा) returned a non-zero EPSG:32644 extent. The preserved WUP point was not shifted and its projected coordinate lies west of that selected village extent. The exact WUP-coordinate plot lookup returned an empty object, which is an exact-point/selected-village miss only. No parcel polygon is retained because the public plot-by-ID geometry endpoint required an Authorization header and no credentials were used. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
